items.title: The Wizards will face a severely injury-depleted Magic team tonight. In addition to having Paolo Banchero, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac and Noah Penda out, the Magic have listed Anthony Black as out for tonight's game because of right ankle injury management.
items.author: Josh Robbins
items.body_excerpt: The Wizards will face a severely injury-depleted Magic team tonight. In addition to having Paolo Banchero, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac and Noah Penda out, the Magic have listed Anthony Black as out for tonight's game because of right ankle injury management.

items.title: My latest for @orlandosentinel.com: #Magic forward Jonathan Isaac has been out due to “left knee injury management.”
items.author: Jason Beede
items.body_excerpt:
My latest for @orlandosentinel.com: #Magic forward Jonathan Isaac has been out due to “left knee injury management.”

But what injury is he actually managing? And does he expect to play this season?

Isaac spoke to the Sentinel in Toronto about it: www.orlandosentinel.com/2026/10/28/o...

media.title: Magic’s Jonathan Isaac calls injury management a ‘slow process’, but says he’ll be back
media.description: Ahead of Wednesday’s game in Toronto, the Orlando Sentinel spoke 1-on-1 with Magic forward Jonathan Isaac to get an update on his left knee injury management.
